[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 150
- Description: Build local media upload pipeline (Courier) — daemon, menu-bar app, docs, MAP wiring
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1492
  
  Details:
  What: built "Courier", the local media-upload pipeline that moves farm/event media zips from Gary's Mac to Sophia's MAP intake funnel (/media/to_process).
  
  Components:
  - chunked_upload.sh — resumable chunked uploader (500 MB chunks, sha256-verified per-chunk and whole-file, internet-aware wait/retry, already-processed manifest guard that skips + deletes any zip already archived on the box).
  - courier.sh + launchd agents (com.garyjob.courier, com.garyjob.courierbar) — keep-alive daemon that survives sleep/wake and reboot; caffeinate keeps the Mac awake while an upload is in flight.
  - CourierBar.app — native macOS menu-bar toggle (Swift/AppKit) with live progress (zip · chunk N/M · % · rate), Start/Stop, Open Log / Open Drop Folder; uses the truesight.me favicon.
  - COURIER.md — documentation + replication checklist (agentic_ai_context PR #1492).
  - Handed oscar_fazenda_2026.zip → oscar-bahia to Sophia in the MAP pipeline Telegram thread.
  
  Why: 12 GB zips can't survive a single uninterrupted transfer over a low-throughput/flaky link; Courier makes uploads resumable, unattended, and observable, and pre-wires zip→farm_id so media doesn't stall.
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1492
- Contributor(s): Deep Seek
- TDG Issued: 250.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
